capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.

storage_to_ram.note: Sequential reads of a flushed temporary file on the selected volume (results volume by default). File creation is excluded. Device/controller caches may contribute; model files on other volumes need separate measurement.

ram_to_vram.note: Pinned RAM to device memory; host wall time includes completed copies and synchronization. Separate microbenchmark, not observed inference traffic or VRAM internal bandwidth.
